title: LIVE WIND — BEAUFORT SCALE
noaa_source: NOAA/NCEP Great Lakes Wave Unstructured v2.1 (GLWUv2.1, WAVEWATCH III) — UGRD/VGRD surface analysis
product_name: NOAA/NCEP Great Lakes Wave Unstructured v2.1 (GLWUv2.1, WAVEWATCH III) — UGRD/VGRD surface analysis
variable: UGRD/VGRD surface wind components, analysis step; speed = sqrt(U^2+V^2), visualized as Beaufort Force 0-12
spatial_resolution_rendered: 1800x1175 canvas over lon [-93.0,-73.5], lat [40.5,49.5] (mean-value binning, no upsampling of source precision)
missing_data_treatment: GRIB2 missing value 9999 and off-water grid points rendered fully transparent; never zero-filled.
shoreline_mask: assets/great_lakes_watermask.png — shared NOAA medium-resolution shoreline water mask (nautical-chart compilation, mean-high-water datum; snapped + polygonized once, full vertex precision, antialiased). Overlay alpha is multiplied by this mask and edge RGB is bled into transparent pixels (anti-fringe for bilinear clients), so every product shares one shoreline.
attribution: Data: US NOAA. This project is not endorsed by NOAA. See DATA_SOURCES.md for exact products and endpoints.
legend_scale_html:
WIND — BEAUFORT SCALE (colors follow force, dark purple = Force 12 only):
F0 — Calm (0–0.99 kt)
F1 — Light air (1–3 kt)
F2 — Light breeze (4–6 kt)
F3 — Gentle breeze (7–10 kt)
F4 — Moderate breeze (11–16 kt)
F5 — Fresh breeze (17–21 kt)
F6 — Strong breeze (22–27 kt)
F7 — High wind (28–33 kt)
F8 — Gale (34–40 kt)
F9 — Strong gale (41–47 kt)
F10 — Storm (48–55 kt)
F11 — Violent storm (56–63 kt)
F12 — Hurricane-force (≥64 kt)
Maximum this run: 26 kt (Beaufort 6). Arrows point where the air moves.
methodology: Wind speed = sqrt(U^2+V^2) from GLWU UGRD/VGRD surface analysis (m/s, direction of motion), x1.94384 -> knots, mapped to WMO Beaufort Force 0-12 with unmodified thresholds. Arrows point along the (U,V) movement vector (no FROM->TOWARD reversal needed for GRIB components); calm (<0.5 m/s) gets no arrow. Overlay alpha cut by the shared GSHHG shoreline mask.
